published_angles.title: The Sifuna Convergence: Inside the Multi-Front Pressure on Nairobi’s Senator
published_angles.angle: Synthesizing these rapid-fire events to expose the sudden convergence of multi-front pressure and strategic positioning surrounding Edwin Sifuna, showing how he has become a critical pivot point for domestic realignments and diplomatic engagement.
published_angles.opening: Lead with Sifuna as the central pivot of a whirlwind 48 hours of high-stakes political maneuvering.
published_angles.structure: Chronological and thematic development tracing the rifts in Linda Mwananchi, the overseas outreach, the diplomatic huddle, and the domestic institutional pushback, closing with a sharp observation on the early battle lines for 2027.
